title: Bind Ecosystem Chat to canonical public StegVerse knowledge corpus
originating_goal: Ecosystem Chat can answer public StegVerse details and explain how to use public modes and integration surfaces.
completion_boundary: Initial canonical public knowledge corpus and deterministic fallback grounding are source-complete and validated. This does not prove exhaustive coverage of every future public StegVerse fact or live sovereign model/provider activation.
collision_boundaries: No TV/TVC credential or route-authority changes.
No StegGate or Master Records authority changes.
No Site mutation; Site orchestration remains authoritative.
Public knowledge output never grants execution or publication authority.
next_task_after_release: Issue #140 owns corpus expansion; existing sovereign Ecosystem runtime lane owns live provider/custody activation.
